verdict.rationale: Aider explicitly supports selecting the underlying model via --model flags, config files, and env vars (AIDER_xxx), and docs/community evidence confirm usage with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, local Ollama models, and Gemini, plus an /architect mode allowing two different models. Community reports (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-18) show real-world switching between providers, including some friction (a tokenizer error for a specific model string), which is a minor bug rather than a lack of multi-provider support. missing for 10: a first-party comparison/benchmark table across providers and confirmation the tokenizer bug was resolved.
